photos.description: This is the last surfing wave before the Payson Park footbridge.  It is present at all levels that I have seen, though it was very nice today.
photos.caption: Surfing at Payson Park
photos.subject: Paul Meinersmann

photos.description: This shows the large eddy on river left that is a great place to putin to paddle down to the footbridge takeout in Payson Park.  The short path down to this is steep and muddy, watch your step.
photos.caption: Powder Mill (?) - looking upstream
photos.author: Paul Meinersmann

photos.description: This is a downstream view of the rapid that is the beginning of the Payson Park section.  It is running very high as there are a number of downstream rocks that are very large that are underwater.  At lower levels, a was out of this would be uncomfortable at best and probably scary.  There is a rock on river right that the current flows into that collects large trees as the river drops.
photos.caption: Powder Mill (?) Rapid
photos.author: Paul Meinersmann

photos.description: This is an overhead shot of the rapid where you can see the double drop.  At even higher levels the top drop becomes a beautiful glassy wave, though the bottom wave takes on an angry and mean look.
photos.caption: Powder Mill (?) Rapid - overhead
photos.author: Paul Meinersmann
